data.name: AboutDescription
data.value: A fast desktop front-end to Jenkins.

data.name: VerificationInvalidCredentials
data.value: Jenkins rejected the user name or API token.

data.name: VerificationNoPermission
data.value: The user has no permission to read Jenkins (Overall/Read).

data.name: VerificationUnreachable
data.value: Nothing answers at this address. Check the address and your network access.

data.name: VerificationUntrustedCertificate
data.value: The operating system doesn't trust this address's certificate. Add its certificate authority to the system certificate store.

data.name: VerificationNotJenkins
data.value: There's no Jenkins at this address.

data.name: VerificationUnexpectedResponse
data.value: Jenkins answered with an error. Try again later.

data.name: InvalidAddress
data.value: Enter the full address, starting with https:// or http://.

data.name: NoConnections
data.value: No Connections yet. Add one from the Connection menu.

data.name: VerificationRedirected
data.value: This address redirects elsewhere. Enter the address Jenkins is served at, e.g. with https://.

data.name: NoCredentialStore
data.value: This system has no credential store to keep the API token in, so the Connection can't be saved.
